$comment: Named, versioned machine-verification suite for cinatra-ai/cinatra — the gate-arm half of the truthful verification-record model (the Truthful Attribution protocol §4). The truthful-attribution-gate reads THIS file at the merged SHA (authoritative, no TOCTOU) when a merge record carries a Gate-suite arm: the cited suiteId@version must equal this file's, the Accountable trailer must equal accountable{github,name,email}, and every requiredContexts entry must have concluded success on the reviewed head. highRiskPaths EXTENDS the central cinatra-ai/ci defaults (the gate verifies the effective set is a superset). High-risk changes (this file is itself one — see **/gate-suite.json in the defaults) require a maintainer review or an authenticated standing-delegation receipt accepted by the pinned engine; the ordinary gate arm alone remains rejected. This file's original birth carried a maintainer Reviewed-by. lastAuditedAt + auditEvidence are the §4 monthly-audit record; the Accountable engineer re-audits monthly and bumps BOTH coupled in one commit (the gate warns >35d, fails the gate arm >65d; the human arm is always still available).
auditEvidence: 2026-11-14 re-audit: both requiredContexts exist at main - source-leak-gate.yml and truthful-attribution-gate.yml, whose jobs with the called jobs of the same ids produce the two declared context names; pins 00ac7b92 (source-leak-gate) and 7c767fe7 (truthful-attribution-gate) equal their callers' uses: and ref: SHAs; the attribution callerPath equals that caller's own path and its allowedEvents (pull_request, push, merge_group) equal that caller's triggers, the source-leak entry declaring neither; 7c767fe7 is a supported engine SHA of the merge road; the central high-risk defaults read version 2026.06 with 35 globs at each of the nine supported engine SHAs and all 35 are in the 56 highRiskPaths (none missing; 21 repository extensions); accountable unchanged (Sandro Groganz, sandro@cinatra.ai, groganz); recorded, not changed: the gate callers at main, the active branch ruleset requiring actions-pinned-gate, gitignore-gate, source-leak-gate and secret-scan-gate, and both suite contexts concluded success at the main head read. Commands: checkout reads of the suite and both callers, gh api contents reads of both reusable workflows at their pins and of config/high-risk-defaults.json at each supported engine, ruleset and check-run reads. Only lastAuditedAt and auditEvidence changed; the version stays, as an audit refresh changes no context, pin or high-risk path.
